Cementoss.name: Cementoss
Cementoss.basicInfo:
Cementoss (Ken Ishiyama), pro hero on U.A. Academy's faculty who teaches modern literature and handles the structural side of practical training: he raises the stages, walls and routes exercises need, repairs training grounds between sessions and ends an unsafe match with a wall. A broad, block-shaped heteromorph with rough gray concrete skin, a squared head, small black eyes and a short gray tail of hair; a sleeveless brown high-collared costume with yellow stripes.
Speaking Style: Calm, mild and precise; speaks softly, addresses students politely by surname, explains plainly and rarely raises his voice.
Combat Role: Terrain controller: reshapes concrete he touches into walls, ramps, pillars and cover, and wins by endurance and structure rather than speed; away from concrete he has little to work with.
Under Pressure: Unhurried. Puts concrete between people and danger first, then decides what to do about the threat.
Cementoss.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The gentlest voice in the Faculty Office belongs to one of its most overwhelming Quirks in a city built of concrete. Motivation: Teach students well and keep them alive long enough to become heroes; he measures a lesson by what they learn about their own limits. Concealment: Nothing sinister; his mildness makes people underestimate how immovable he is, and he lets them. Leverage: A student's safety; a student who keeps trying after hitting the wall; a direct request from Principal Nezu. Connections: Principal Nezu, who assigns the faculty's roles; Ectoplasm, whose clones spar with students on the terrain Cementoss builds; Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head), Vlad King and the other Hero Course teachers, who book his terrain for their classes; Recovery Girl, whom he calls the moment a match ends in injury. Knowledge: Knows the load limits of every concrete training ground on campus and favors students who come to a session with a plan. All Might's odd hours are his own business, and Cementoss does not ask why. Canon voice & behavior: Speaks quietly even mid-fight; raises a wall between two students before either finishes a bad decision; explains afterward, kindly and exactly, what the student failed to see. Thread: How much protection helps students grow and how much holds them back.
QUIRK: Cement. He reshapes concrete he touches and any concrete joined to it, so one palm on a slab can raise walls, pillars and ramps across it. He creates none and needs contact with enough concrete nearby; shaping takes a moment, so a fast or airborne opponent can outrun a wall and a strong one can smash through it.
personality: Composed: Stays unhurried and soft-spoken whether grading essays or holding back a fight.
Protective: Raises a wall between students and danger before anyone asks, and only then sizes up the problem.
Firm: Stops an unsafe match without hesitation or debate, however close the result.
Patient teacher: Lets students spend themselves against his concrete, then shows them calmly where the plan failed.
Speaking style: Calm, mild, precise directions; he explains rather than scolds, and the quiet voice carries authority.
abilities: Cement: Reshapes concrete he touches and any concrete joined to it; he needs contact and existing concrete, and works at the speed of shaping, not instantly.
Separation wall: Raises a barrier between combatants to end a fight without trapping or crushing anyone; a heavy enough blow breaks it, so he raises another.
Terrain design: Builds cliffs, pillars, pits, stages and routes for exercises and school events, and reshapes Gym Gamma to fit each class or student.
Rescue support: Shores up failing concrete, seals a breach or opens an exit through a wall so people can get out; steel and earth are beyond him.
Structural judgment: Reads load and stability before moving material, so a reshaped slab never brings down what it supports.
Fighting style: Fights by attrition: wall after wall between the opponent and their goal, closing the space around them until they tire.
Cementoss.visualDescription: A broad, block-shaped man whose gray skin has the rough, pitted texture of poured concrete, with a large squared head, squared limbs, small black eyes and short gray hair tied in a small tail at the back of his head. He wears his hero costume: a sleeveless brown suit with yellow stripes and a tall collar, with matching brown shorts. Calm, mild expression.
